checks.details: Loop 2 re-run (tests/audit/check2_5_dom.py, check2b_p0_carryover.py, check5b_modeA_paths.py): all loop-1 gate cases still block. Defect path fixed for gold and silver: FY2025-26 SSOT-matched P0 then switch to Aug-2026 (post-13-May) benchmark -> 'P0 REQUIRED', nothing computed, stale value cleared from the field, button disabled; switching back to FY2025-26 shows 'SSOT FY 2025-26 premium cleared' and does not resurrect it; pre-May matched P0 still computes; explicit user P0 (incl. 5.61) post-May still computes and is labelled user; live P0 shows its as-of date and 'indicative: timing gap'. FAIL: the 'use FY 2025-26 SSOT premium' button writes 5.37% into the P0 field tagged source=user; switching the benchmark to Aug 2026 (anchor date 2026-08-31, after 13 May) leaves that pre-hike premium in force with no banner (gold and silver), so a pre-duty-hike SSOT premium silently feeds a post-hike anchor, which G4 exists to prevent.

A: dln 0.024790169, base 148,639.50 identical at lambda 0/0.25/1, bear/bull match. B: dln -0.004301692, base 233,991.27. E: tol 0/1/NaN/neg clamp to [0.005,0.5] no NaN; 1W no anchor blocked with exact banner; M0 skill exactly 0; live window below minimum -> NOT YET MEASURABLE. Extras vs own code: ratio 6x6 sigma, premVar off, mode (b) x sqrt(1.5), mode (c) hybrid and rho fallback -0.40, empirical q10/q90, post-1990 trend, silver slope 0.83 pass-through, ratio fixture, unit conversions (tola 1.166380, 995/999 only, Standard Gold rejected). checks.name: Honest accuracy (G8)
checks.details: Own walk-forward recomputation of 1Y M0/M1 hit rate, MAE, 10-90 coverage and skill for gold and silver equals the UI to 1e-9 (n=45; gold M0 57.8% vs M1 51.1%, silver 55.6% vs 48.9%). Every hit-rate cell has the no-change rate and n beside it (4 backtest tables, meter, scorecard); live 1W/1M show NOT YET MEASURABLE (n 0 of 52/24); imported scorecard shows NYM at 51 scored 1W entries and numbers with no-change benchmark and n at 52; monthly flagged 'indicative: small sample'; M0 skill 0.00. Look-ahead: perturbing and permuting FY>K rows in master_yearly, decomposition, duty_vs_premium and monthly leaves every forecast, range, sigma and slope at origins <=K bit-identical for K in 1999-00/2009-10/2017-18/2023-24 and monthly cutoffs; positive control (changing the past) is detected. Meter: gold 1Y (a) own Phi(ln1.1/s)-Phi(ln0.9/s)=58.37% vs UI 58.4%; all (a)/(b) rows and labels and a tol=5%/target=55% case match own Phi. No unbacked accuracy sentence on any page. Note (not a defect): engine slices decomposition rows by array order, so correctness relies on F1's chronological order. Loop-2 regression: still pass (scorecard minimum-sample test now run in Mode B, since Mode A blanks live-scored entries by design).

defects.trace: out/live_signals.json derived.p0_silver_pct (19.123%, 2026-11-18) and anchors.in_silver_rs_kg (2026-11-19) / world_silver_usd_oz (2026-11-18, STALE); out/live_history.json 2026-11-18 row time_basis 'Gap world->IBJA ~3.5 h on a -1.9% day'; out/fetch_signals.py:73-89
defects.fix: Silver P0 does pair Indian, world and INR values of the same date (18 Nov: 164,506 vs US$46.01 vs 93.3558 reproduces 19.123%) but not the same time basis (world 0242 GMT vs IBJA AM) and it is dated a day before the silver anchor (19 Nov). The row carries 'Gap' in time_basis, so the spec 3.4 alignment rule would exclude it from premium estimates, yet it supplies P0. Add machine-readable derived.p0_gold_date / p0_silver_date plus a timing_gap_hours field, mark P0 'indicative' in the schema, or leave p0_silver_pct null until a same-time world silver quote is read. Disclosed in notes and shown as 'indicative' in the UI, so not blocking by itself.

advisories: engine.forecast() with 'spot' shorthand and no date/basis fills 'unspecified'/'user-stated' (src/engine.js:277); UI blocks it, library does not (A2, low).
High-duty fact note is keyed to the scenario's new duty (src/ui_forecast.js:163); it disappears for a 15%->6% scenario and while blocked although the duty in force is 15% (A2, low).
Engine M3/M2 rolling windows slice decomposition_log_points by array order (src/engine.js forecastAtOrigin/backtestMonthly); sort by fiscal_year to be robust (A2, low).
